hero.title: Build Faster with JHipster + Tailwind
hero.subtitle: A modern, production-ready starter combining Spring Boot, React, and Tailwind CSS for rapid application development.

about.title: About Our Platform
about.description1: Our platform combines the power of modern web technologies to deliver exceptional experiences. Built with industry-leading frameworks and best practices, we provide a solid foundation for your next big idea.
about.description2: Whether you're building a startup MVP or scaling an enterprise application, our stack is designed to grow with you. From authentication and database management to responsive UI components, everything you need is ready out of the box.

feature1.title: Rapid Scaffolding
feature1.description: Generate entities, services, routes, and UI fast with consistent patterns.

feature2.title: Modern Styling
feature2.description: Tailwind utility-first classes keep styles lean while remaining expressive.

feature3.title: Production Ready
feature3.description: Robust architecture with security, internationalization, and quality tooling.

step1.title: Set Up Your Project
step1.description: Get started in minutes with our pre-configured setup. Install dependencies, configure your database, and launch your development environment with simple commands. No complex configuration required.

step2.title: Build Your Features
step2.description: Use our powerful generators to scaffold entities, create REST APIs, and build UI components. Focus on your business logic while we handle the boilerplate code. Customize everything to match your requirements.

step3.title: Deploy & Scale
step3.description: Ship your application with confidence using our production-ready configurations. Built-in Docker support, cloud-native architecture, and performance optimizations ensure your app runs smoothly at any scale.
